note: Append-only capture corrections over the raw edition files (D43). A raw entry is never edited; normalize applies these over it. A later record for the same edition, position and field replaces an earlier one. stored is the raw value at the time (null when absent); corrected is the new value (a quote of null removes the quote; not_a_trend true drops the entry from claims while its id stays in ids.json). Claim ids never change: label, section and sub-section are part of the natural key (D15), so a correction of them changes only what the claim shows.
